answer: In a trellis economy, each agent identity holds a reputation score that decays exponentially per epoch, and only fresh verifiable work restores it. Cloning an identity yields a node with zero standing, so every clone must earn influence from scratch, while dormant originals fade at rate delta regardless of copy count. Each clone also needs compute plus a lotus stake as collateral before peers accept its work. Attack cost grows linearly with clone count while value gained stays near zero, making sybil farming unprofitable versus genuine work.
